dataset: All 30 development tasks (60 attempts per effort level, 120 total attempts)

scientific_findings.key_discovery: Under low reasoning effort, the science arm overtakes baseline (13/30 vs 12/30, 43.3% vs 40.0%), eliminating all baseline-only wins (002 and 009 both solved) while preserving the science-only win on 077.
scientific_findings.compensatory_mechanism: Pre-extracted scientific context acts as an external structural memory that compensates for reduced test-time reasoning tokens.
scientific_findings.efficiency: Science arm achieves higher solve rate with fewer tokens and faster turnaround.
